content.short: Stryke is a high-efficiency decentralized options protocol on Arbitrum featuring concentrated liquidity AMMs.
content.description:
Stryke is a premier decentralized options platform, formerly known as Dopex, designed to maximize liquidity and capital efficiency for on-chain derivatives. The protocol utilizes a unique Concentrated Liquidity AMM (CLAMM) model that allows liquidity providers to allocate their capital with extreme precision, significantly improving pricing for both buyers and writers. This approach ensures that users can interact with complex option strategies within a transparent and non-custodial environment, leveraging the high speed and low cost of the Arbitrum network.

Powered by the SYK token, the platform focuses on providing institutional-grade financial tools while maintaining a user-friendly interface for retail participants. Stryke serves as a vital infrastructure layer for the decentralized economy, offering specialized products like Atlantic Options and Option Vaults to optimize risk management and yield generation. Through its commitment to technological innovation and ecosystem-wide collaboration, Stryke is building the essential framework for the next generation of on-chain options trading, where capital efficiency is a primary utility.
content.meta: Stryke provides professional-grade decentralized options and concentrated liquidity pools on the Arbitrum network.
